newsitem.title: CHINA: China retail sales up 16.1 pct in Jan-Feb.
newsitem.headline: China retail sales up 16.1 pct in Jan-Feb.

text.p: China's retail sales reached 450.2 billion yuan ($54.2 billion) in the January-February period, up 16.1 percent over the same period last year, the State Statistical Bureau said on Tuesday.
The rise in what is formally known as retail sales of consumer products was 12.6 percent, adjusting for the impact of inflation.
Retail sales expanded 17 percent in cities and 14.6 percent in rural areas during the period over the same months last year, the bureau said.
